messages.subject: Widening participation scholarship application deadline, intro workshop 19 May 2023
parts:
Interactive introductory distance sampling training, second announcement

Official registration for the July 2023 workshop will begin the week of 22 May 2023, but applications are now being accepted for the widening participation scholarship (details below).

Widening participation scholarship

One place will have the registration fee waived, for participants from under-represented groups.  Details of eligibility and application process at http://workshops.distancesampling.org/widening-participation. Deadline for scholarship applications for the July 2023 introductory workshop is tomorrow 19 May 2023.   

Additional details

http://workshops.distancesampling.org/intro-jul-2023.html

At the webpage above, you will find a link to the St Andrews online shop where payment is made. Registration will open the week of 22 May 2023.  After you register, I will contact you with additional details regarding workshop electronic materials, etc.

Feel free to contact me with questions. Please share this announcement with interested colleagues.


Eric Rexstad

Centre for Research into Ecological and Environmental Modelling
